description: Cold start to first TRANSCEIVER_INFO on every port. Measures how long after boot the daemon has published identity for the whole plant.
metric: p50/p95 latency, boot -> INFO row present for all ports
blocked_by: TRANSCEIVER_INFO is posted by SfpStateUpdateTask, which this harness does not drive - it wires only DomInfoUpdateTask. Needs the SFP task added to bin/trace.rs and bench_dom.py. On the DUT this is also confounded by two artefacts that must be neutralised first: RUST_SETTLE_SECS (default 15) and the daemon's self-re-exec for --enable_sff_mgr (daemon.rs:190), which puts two process starts inside any boot measurement.
